comment: The vectors pinning Prima.Feed, read by apps/prima/test/prima/feed_test.exs and, for the stream payload, by the toolkit's JavaScript tests (apps/cyfr/assets/test/toolkit/worker.test.mjs). Every row is plain JSON. Every valid binding reads and writes back as its `json`, its result shape normalized; every invalid binding is refused at `path`, an RFC 6901 pointer into it, for `reason`, one of `reasons`. `inputs` are the component inputs a binding (by index) or its run action (by index) runs with, and `crons` each interval's cron expression. Each binding's `results` pass or are refused at `path` for `reason`. Each envelope is the stream payload for its binding id, binding, revision, time and result: it names the binding and the feed and never the operation, args, reference or interval. A binding's args and a result are bounded by the bytes of their JSON text: `args_max_bytes` and `result_max_bytes`.

reasons.type: a value of another JSON type than its position takes
reasons.null: null where the shape is not nullable
reasons.max: a string or list longer than its max
reasons.enum: a value none of the values its position admits
reasons.unknown_field: an object key its fields do not name
reasons.required: a required field or key absent
reasons.unknown_type: a shape whose type is none of the types
reasons.unknown_key: a key its object does not take
reasons.range: a bound or count outside its range
reasons.name: a name outside its grammar
reasons.duplicate: a value repeated where values are distinct
reasons.depth: a shape deeper than its limit
reasons.text: a label outside its code-point range or with a control character
reasons.reference: not a canonically spelt, versionless catalyst or formula reference
reasons.size: JSON text longer than its bound
reasons.json: a value Prima.Json.encode/1 cannot write as JSON text

invalid.why: a binding carries no id: its id is its row's
a name outside the feed-name grammar
a name beginning with a hyphen
a label with a control character
an operation with a control character
args past 4096 bytes of JSON text
an interval of 7 does not divide an hour
an interval is a whole number
a result shape outside the grammar
a run action lacking its operation
a run action lacking its args
a run action's args past 4096 bytes
a refresh action carrying an operation
an action key no action takes
an action's label past 40 code points
an action's name outside the grammar
a result with a key its shape does not name
a result that is not an object
a null where the field is not nullable

envelopes.why: an accepted result, its time given at another offset
a binding with no actions, at revision 0
